    15	splitting field and all of `SepClosedTranslatedDropData`.

    17	The positive twist stays tied to the presenting class of `mu`.  Its exponent is chosen above
    18	both the FLV threshold and the amount needed to put the twisted class in degree at least the
    19	genus.  The dense-point, residue-one, finite-support, and base-subtraction fields are then filled
    20	by the rational-point-image constructor, so the output feeds the existing translated-drop
    21	consumer without replacing `mu` by an unrelated Picard class.

   364	    (hW₀ : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W₀ =
   365	      M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   366	        (chartTwistClass C m (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)))
   367	    (excess : ℕ)
   368	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W₀ = (genus C : ℤ) + excess)
   369	    (h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   370	      ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W₀) 1)) :
   371	    SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) μ where
   372	  m := m
   373	  M₀ := M₀
   374	  hM₀ := hM₀
   375	  W₀ := W₀
   376	  hW₀ := hW₀
   377	  genusValue := genus C
   378	  excess := excess
   379	  hχ := chi_moduleKSheaf C

   381	  h1 := h1
   382	  P := rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L
   383	  hdense := dense_rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L
   384	  hPcl := ne_genericPoint_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage C

   399	    (hM₀ : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K μ) =

   401	    (W₀ : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor)

   405	    (excess : ℕ)
   406	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W₀ = (genus C : ℤ) + excess)
   407	    (h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   408	      ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W₀) 1)) :

    10	/-!
    11	# Effective residual representatives for the translated rank-one cover
    12	
    13	The greedy translated-drop package records `h⁰ = 1` for `W₀ - S`, but it does not
    14	assert that this chosen divisor is effective.  A positive global section nevertheless
    15	produces an effective representative of the same class.  This file exposes that
    16	representative with its degree-genus certificate, while retaining the input class and
    17	the existing translated `IsSplitWitness` consumer.

    35	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k]
    36	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    37	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    38	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

    41	
    42	section ResidualRepresentative
    43	
    44	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    45	  [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L]
    46	  [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]

    48	/-! The product curve instances are the same base-change package used by the
    49	general producer.  `exists_effective_of_h0_pos` does not require the finite
    50	cohomology instances, so this bridge only installs the geometric hypotheses. -/
    51	
    52	omit [IsSepClosed k] [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] in
    53	theorem exists_effective_residual_degree_genus
    54	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K))
    55	    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) μ)
    56	    (r : SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) μ d) :
    57	    ∃ E : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor,
    58	      0 ≤ E ∧
    59	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L E = (d.genusValue : ℤ) ∧
    60	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L E =
    61	          Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L (d.W₀ - r.S) := by
    62	  haveI : IsIntegral (relCurve C L) := instIsIntegralBaseChange C L
    63	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
    64	      (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    65	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L
    66	  haveI : QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    67	    instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L
    68	  have hpos : 0 < Sheaf.h0
    69	      ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L (d.W₀ - r.S)) := by
    70	    rw [r.h0_one]
    71	    norm_num
    72	  obtain ⟨E, hE, hEc⟩ :=
    73	    exists_effective_of_h0_pos (K := L) (d.W₀ - r.S) hpos
    74	  have hdegResidual : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L (d.W₀ - r.S) =
    75	      (d.genusValue : ℤ) := by
    76	    rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' L, d.hdeg, r.degree]
    77	    ring
    78	  exact ⟨E, hE,
    79	    (deg_eq_deg_of_picClass_eq (K := L) hEc).trans hdegResidual,
    80	    hEc⟩
    81	
    82	/-! The general consumer keeps the finite separable extension and the exact
    83	input class in scope, and adds the effective degree-genus representative to
    84	the already landed translated-drop result. -/
    85	
    86	theorem exists_sepClosedTranslatedDropEffective_general
    87	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K)) :
    88	    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra K L)
    89	        (_ : IsScalarTower k K L) (_ : Module.Finite K L)
    90	        (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L)
    91	        (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) μ)
    92	        (r : SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) μ d)
    93	        (E : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor),
    94	      0 ≤ E ∧
    95	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L E = (d.genusValue : ℤ) ∧
    96	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L E =
    97	          Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L (d.W₀ - r.S) ∧
    98	        IsSplitWitness C
    99	          (μ * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z) (overSpec k K)) := by
   100	  obtain ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, d, ⟨r⟩⟩ :=
   101	    exists_sepClosedTranslatedDropResult_general (C := C) μ
   102	  letI := hLfield
   103	  letI := hkL
   104	  letI := hKL
   105	  letI := htow
   106	  letI := hfin
   107	  letI := hsep
   108	  obtain ⟨E, hE, hEdeg, hEclass⟩ :=
   109	    exists_effective_residual_degree_genus μ d r
   110	  exact ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, d, r, E,
   111	    hE, hEdeg, hEclass, r.translated⟩
   112	
   113	end ResidualRepresentative

   115	end

   117	end AlgebraicGeometry

    11	/-!
    12	# The translated rank-one cover brick
    13	
    14	This file records the part of the separably-closed cover argument that is already consumable by
    15	the landed fibre API.  A `BaseFieldTranslationDrop` keeps the input class `lambda` in the
    16	presentation equation, chooses its base-field translating class explicitly, and records the
    17	positive-twist/point-subtraction output.  The consumer below turns that output into the exact
    18	`IsSplitWitness` shape used by `chartLocus`.
    19	
    20	The arbitrary-affine family of `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` objects required by
    21	`PicRankOneOpen` is deliberately not inferred from `h0 = 1` and `H1 = 0`: no such producer is
    22	landed in the current API.  The final theorem therefore exposes the field-level consumer and
    23	keeps that family producer as an explicit integration obligation.
    24	-/
    25	
    26	set_option autoImplicit false
    27	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    28	
    29	universe u
    30	
    31	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    32	open TopologicalSpace Opposite
    33	
    34	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    35	
    36	open AlgebraicJacobian
    37	
    38	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    39	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    40	
    41	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    42	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    43	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    44	
    45	noncomputable section
    46	
    47	/-! ## The positive-twist input -/
    48	
    49	section PositiveTwist
    50	
    51	variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y]
    52	  [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    53	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    54	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    55	  [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    56	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
    57	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 1)]
    58	
    59	/-- The FLV class theorem in the spelling used by the translated-cover lane.
    60	
    61	The class `l` is the presenting class of the input fibre, while `theta` is the positive
    62	base-field twist.  Keeping this as a named wrapper makes the positive-twist step visible at the
    63	call site; it does not manufacture a presentation or hide the input class in an unrelated
    64	existential. -/
    65	theorem exists_positive_twist_vanishing
    66	    (π : Y ⟶ P1 K) [IsFinite π] [IsDominant π]
    67	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap K = Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    68	    (l θ : Y.CechPic) (hθ : 1 ≤ classDeg K θ) :
    69	    ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ n₀, ∀ W : Y.CurveDivisor,
    70	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K W = l * θ ^ n →
    71	        Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K W) 1) := by
    72	  exact exists_subsingleton_hModule_one_of_one_le_classDeg_of_isFinite_toP1
    73	    π hπ l θ hθ
    74	
    75	end PositiveTwist
    76	
    77	/-! ## The lambda-tied drop package -/
    78	
    79	section DropPackage
    80	
    81	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    82	  [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L]
    83	  [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    84	
    85	/-- Data for the positive twist and the subsequent point subtraction.
    86	
    87	`hM₀` ties the splitting field presentation to the particular input `mu`; `hW₀` says that the
    88	divisor being reduced is in the positive twist class (the chart index is zero at this stage).
    89	`baseSubtraction` is intentionally an explicit class-level bridge: it says that the divisor
    90	returned by the greedy reduction is represented by a base-field divisor.  The current tree has
    91	the graph-class version of this bridge but no divisor pullback operation, so this hypothesis is
    92	kept visible rather than replaced by a fieldwise existential. -/
    93	structure SepClosedTranslatedDropData (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K)) where
    94	  m : ℕ
    95	  M₀ : (relCurve C L).CechPic
    96	  hM₀ : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K μ) =
    97	    PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M₀)
    98	  W₀ : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor
    99	  hW₀ : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W₀ =
   100	    M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   101	      (chartTwistClass C m (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor))
   102	  genusValue : ℕ
   103	  excess : ℕ
   104	  hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (genusValue : ℤ)
   105	  hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W₀ = (genusValue : ℤ) + excess
   106	  h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   107	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W₀) 1)
   108	  P : Set ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   109	  hdense : ∀ U : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).Opens,
   110	    (U : Set ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)).Nonempty → (P ∩ U).Nonempty
   111	  hPcl : ∀ x ∈ P, x ≠ genericPoint ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   112	  hPdeg : ∀ x ∈ P, ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).residueDeg L x = 1
   113	  baseSubtraction : ∀ (S : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor),
   114	    0 ≤ S → Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L S = (excess : ℤ) →
   115	      (∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint _),
   116	        coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ P) →
   117	      ∃ Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor,
   118	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L S =
   119	          Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   120	            ((chartTwistClass C 0 Z)⁻¹)
   121	
   122	/-- The output of the positive-twist/drop construction, tied to both the input class and the
   123	base-field translating divisor.
   124	
   125	The final field is the existing fibre consumer.  In particular, `S` is not merely a divisor
   126	with the right cohomology: `baseClass` identifies its class with the base change of `Z`, and
   127	`translated` is about `mu` translated by the resulting base-field class
   128	`chartTwistClass C d.m Z`. -/
   129	structure SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   130	    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) μ) where
   131	  S : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor
   132	  Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor
   133	  nonnegative : 0 ≤ S
   134	  degree : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L S = (d.excess : ℤ)
   135	  support : ∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint _),
   136	    coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ d.P
   137	  baseClass : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L S =
   138	    Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) ((chartTwistClass C 0 Z)⁻¹)
   139	  h0_one : Sheaf.h0
   140	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L (d.W₀ - S)) = 1
   141	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   142	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L (d.W₀ - S)) 1)
   143	  translated : IsSplitWitness C
   144	    (μ * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C d.m Z) (overSpec k K))
   145	
   146	/-- Positive twisting followed by point subtraction produces the exact field-level translated
   147	rank-one witness.
   148	
   149	The greedy theorem supplies `S`, `h0 = 1`, and preservation of `H1 = 0`.  The explicit
   150	`baseSubtraction` bridge then supplies the base divisor `Z`; class arithmetic shows that
   151	`W₀ - S` presents `mu` translated by the base-field class `chartTwistClass C d.m Z`.  The last
   152	line applies the existing `IsSplitWitness` consumer, so no unrelated Picard class can satisfy
   153	the conclusion. -/
   154	theorem exists_sepClosedTranslatedDropResult
   155	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   156	    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) μ) :
   157	    Nonempty (SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) μ d) := by
   158	  obtain ⟨-, S, hS0, hSdeg, hSsupport, hS0one, hS1⟩ :=
   159	    exists_isSplitWitness_of_drop C μ d.m
   160	      (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   161	      d.genusValue d.excess d.hχ d.M₀ d.hM₀ d.W₀ d.hW₀ d.hdeg d.h1
   162	      d.P d.hdense d.hPcl d.hPdeg
   163	  obtain ⟨Z, hSZ⟩ := d.baseSubtraction S hS0 hSdeg hSsupport
   164	  have hW : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L (d.W₀ - S) =
   165	      d.M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   166	        (chartTwistClass C d.m Z) := by
   167	    have hW₀ := d.hW₀
   168	    unfold relCurveMap relCurve at hW₀ hSZ ⊢
   169	    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_add, Scheme.picClass_neg,
   170	      hW₀, hSZ]
   171	    simp only [map_inv, inv_inv]
   172	    rw [mul_assoc, ← map_mul]
   173	    simp only [chartTwistClass, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_zero, inv_one, mul_one,
   174	      pow_zero, one_mul]
   175	  have htranslated : IsSplitWitness C
   176	      (μ * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C d.m Z) (overSpec k K)) :=
   177	    isSplitWitness_of_witness_twistClass C μ d.m Z d.M₀ d.hM₀
   178	      (d.W₀ - S) hW hS1
   179	  exact ⟨{
   180	    S := S
   181	    Z := Z
   182	    nonnegative := hS0
   183	    degree := hSdeg
   184	    support := hSsupport
   185	    baseClass := hSZ
   186	    h0_one := hS0one
   187	    h1_vanishing := hS1
   188	    translated := htranslated
   189	  }⟩
   190	
   191	end DropPackage
   192	
   193	end
   194	
   195	end AlgebraicGeometry

    10	/-!
    11	# The translated cover in the genus-degree layer
    12	
    13	The separably closed translated-drop producer already supplies an exact lambda-tied
    14	`IsSplitWitness`.  This file records the additional degree calculation needed to place that
    15	translated class in the native `picDegLayer C (genus C)` carrier.  The calculation uses the
    16	actual residual class `W₀ - S`, its base subtraction, and the presenting equation for the original
    17	input class; it does not replace the input by a fieldwise existential.
    18	
    19	The arbitrary-affine `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` family remains a separate integration
    20	obligation.  Consequently this file stops at the exact ambient layer consumed by `PicRankOneOpen`
    21	and does not assert locus membership without that protected presentation producer.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    26	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    27	
    28	universe u
    29	
    30	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    31	open TopologicalSpace Opposite

    33	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    34	
    35	open AlgebraicJacobian
    36	
    37	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    38	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    39	
    40	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
    41	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    42	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    43	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    44	
    45	noncomputable section
    46	
    47	/-! A field point of `overSpec k K` is induced by its structure-field map, so degree at that
    48	point agrees with degree at the identity.  Keeping this local avoids enlarging the base-change
    49	API for a fact used only by the layer bridge. -/
    50	private theorem degAt_eq_degAt_id_of_overSpec
    51	    {K K' : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Field K'] [Algebra k K']
    52	    (lam : picEt C (overSpec k K))
    53	    (t : overSpec k K' ⟶ overSpec k K) :
    54	    degAt lam t = degAt lam (𝟙 (overSpec k K)) := by
    55	  let phiRing : K →+* K' := (Spec.preimage t.left).hom
    56	  have hw : t.left ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)) =
    57	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K')) := by
    58	    change t.left ≫ (overSpec k K).hom = (overSpec k K').hom
    59	    exact Over.w t
    60	  have hcat :
    61	      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K) ≫ Spec.preimage t.left =
    62	        CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K') := by
    63	    calc
    64	      _ = Spec.preimage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) ≫
    65	          Spec.preimage t.left := by rw [Spec.preimage_map]
    66	      _ = Spec.preimage
    67	          (t.left ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) :=
    68	        (Spec.preimage_comp t.left
    69	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).symm
    70	      _ = Spec.preimage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K'))) :=
    71	        congrArg Spec.preimage hw
    72	      _ = _ := Spec.preimage_map _
    73	  have hcomm : ∀ x : k,
    74	      phiRing (algebraMap k K x) = algebraMap k K' x := by
    75	    intro x

    96	/-- The exact degree-genus-layer object carried by a translated-drop result.
    97	
    98	The underlying class is the result's translated input, and the subtype proof is computed from
    99	the residual class `W₀ - S`.  Thus the output is directly an element of the `picDegLayer` target
   100	used by `PicRankOneOpen`, rather than a parallel existential carrier. -/
   101	noncomputable def SepClosedTranslatedDropResult.rankOneLayer
   102	    (mu : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   103	    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) mu)
   104	    (r : SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) mu d) :
   105	    picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k K) := by
   106	  let translated : picEt C (overSpec k K) := mu * thetaFamily C
   107	    (chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z) (overSpec k K)
   108	  have hgenusInt : (d.genusValue : ℤ) = (genus C : ℤ) := by
   109	    have hchiC := chi_moduleKSheaf C
   110	    linarith [d.hχ]
   111	  have hW₀ := d.hW₀
   112	  have hSZ := r.baseClass
   113	  have hW :
   114	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L (d.W₀ - r.S) =
   115	        d.M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   116	          (chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z) := by
   117	    unfold relCurveMap relCurve at hW₀ hSZ ⊢
   118	    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_add,
   119	      Scheme.picClass_neg, hW₀, hSZ]
   120	    simp only [map_inv, inv_inv]
   121	    rw [mul_assoc, ← map_mul]
   122	    simp only [chartTwistClass, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_zero,
   123	      inv_one, mul_one, pow_zero, one_mul]
   124	  have hpresentation :=
   125	    picEtAffineEquiv_map_chartTwistFactor_eq_unit
   126	      C mu d.M₀ d.hM₀ d.m r.Z
   127	  have hdegreeAtId :
   128	      degAt translated (𝟙 (overSpec k K)) = (genus C : ℤ) := by
   129	    unfold translated degAt
   130	    rw [picEtMap_id]
   131	    rw [← classDeg_presenting_eq_degAff C L _ _ hpresentation]
   132	    rw [← hW, classDeg_picClass, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' L, d.hdeg,
   133	      r.degree, hgenusInt]
   134	    ring
   135	  refine ⟨translated, ?_⟩
   136	  intro K' _ _ t
   137	  rw [degAt_eq_degAt_id_of_overSpec]
   138	  exact hdegreeAtId

    15	The density oracle used by the translated-cover drop has to record residue degree one at the
    16	chosen points.  This file supplies that arithmetic bridge from the actual section certificate,
    17	rather than adding `residueDeg = 1` as an unrelated existential field.  The relative specialization
    18	is the exact point produced by `Over.rationalPointBaseChange`.

    35	/-! ## Sections have residue degree one -/
    36	
    37	theorem residueDeg_one_of_section
    38	    {K : Type u} [Field K]
    39	    {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))}
    40	    {e : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ X.left}
    41	    (he : e ≫ X.hom = 𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
    42	    {x : X.left}
    43	    (hx : e.base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K) = x) :
    44	    X.left.residueDeg K x = 1 := by
    45	  letI : Algebra K (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) := stalkAlgebra X.hom x
    46	  have h := bijective_algebraMap_residueField_of_section X he hx
    47	  have hmap :
    48	      algebraMap K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)) =
    49	        X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap K x := by
    50	    ext c
    51	    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
    52	      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)),
    53	      IsLocalRing.ResidueField.algebraMap_eq, Scheme.residueOverAlgebraMap,
    54	      algebraMap_overStalkAlgebra]
    55	    simp [stalkStructureHom, Scheme.overAlgebraMap]
    56	    rfl
    57	  letI : Algebra K (X.left.residueField x) :=
    58	    (X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap K x).toAlgebra
    59	  unfold Scheme.residueDeg
    60	  change Module.finrank K (X.left.residueField x) = 1
    61	  apply Module.finrank_of_bijective_algebraMap
    62	  change Function.Bijective (X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap K x)
    63	  rw [← hmap]
    64	  exact h

    69	    {k : Type u} [Field k]

    71	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    72	    (p : Spec (.of k) ⟶ C.left)

    74	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).residueDeg L
    75	      ((Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint L)) = 1 := by
    76	  apply residueDeg_one_of_section
    77	    (X := Over.mk (snd C (overSpec k L)).left)

    79	  · exact Over.rationalPointBaseChange_snd C L p hp
    80	  · rfl

    82	/-- The graph point of a field-valued point has residue degree one. -/
    83	theorem residueDeg_one_of_graphPoint
    84	    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    85	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    86	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    87	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    88	    (t : overSpec k K ⟶ C) :
    89	    (C ⊗ overSpec k K).left.residueDeg K (Over.graphPoint C t) = 1 := by
    90	  exact residueDeg_one_of_section
    91	    (X := Over.mk (snd C (overSpec k K)).left)
    92	    (e := (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left)
    93	    (by
    94	      exact congrArg (fun q : overSpec k K ⟶ overSpec k K => q.left)
    95	        (Over.sectionOfPoint_snd t))
    96	    (by
    97	      change (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left.base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K) =
    98	        (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left.base default
    99	      exact congrArg (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left.base
   100	        (Subsingleton.elim _ _))

   102	/-- The graph presentation has multiplicity one at its graph point.
   103	
   104	`presentationDivisor_graphLocalEquations` initially records the multiplicity as an order.
   105	The graph class and its residue field both have degree one, so the degree formula forces that
   106	order to be one.  This is the pointwise input for finite-support class descent below. -/
   107	theorem graphPicClass_eq_picClass_single
   108	    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   109	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   110	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   111	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   112	    (t : overSpec k K ⟶ C) :
   113	    Over.graphPicClass C t =
   114	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K
   115	        (Scheme.CurveDivisor.single (graphPoint_ne_genericPoint C t) 1) := by
   116	  let hx := graphPoint_ne_genericPoint C t
   117	  let a : ℤ :=
   118	    Multiplicative.toAdd
   119	      (Scheme.ordZ ((C ⊗ overSpec k K).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
   120	        hx ((Over.graphLocalEquations C t).presentation.elem (Over.graphPoint C t)))
   121	  have hsingle :
   122	      Scheme.presentationDivisor K (Over.graphLocalEquations C t).presentation =
   123	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.single hx a := by
   124	    exact presentationDivisor_graphLocalEquations C t
   125	  have hclass :
   126	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K (Scheme.CurveDivisor.single hx a) =
   127	        Over.graphPicClass C t := by
   128	    rw [← hsingle, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_presentationDivisor K,
   129	      Scheme.LocalEquations.presentation_picClass]
   130	    rfl
   131	  have hdeg := classDeg_graphPicClass C t
   132	  rw [← hclass, classDeg_picClass, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_single'] at hdeg
   133	  rw [residueDeg_one_of_graphPoint C t, Nat.cast_one, mul_one] at hdeg
   134	  rw [hdeg] at hclass
   135	  exact hclass.symm

   138	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
   139	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   140	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))) where

   160	theorem isPullback (D : PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :

   198	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   199	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)))

   211	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=

   216	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}

     9	/-!
    10	# COVERAGE NEEDS NO DROP, NO ORACLE, AND NO STEP 6
    11	
    12	A retraction of this lane's own account of B-5, and it removes a residue rather than adding one.
    13	
    14	`Picard/Pic0ChartCoverageTest.lean`'s DEFECT section establishes — correctly — that the
    15	`w4-datb` §1.2 argument as written runs the greedy drop at `Z := 0` and feeds the drop's
    16	**output** `Σ` back as the chart index's `Z`, so that the two stages carry different `Z`, and
    17	that this feedback ("step 6") is not discharged anywhere.  It records step 6 as one of B-5's
    18	open residues.
    19	
    20	**Step 6 is not a residue, because coverage does not need the drop at all.**
    21	
    22	## Why: read what `chartLocus` actually asks for
    23	
    24	`IsSplitWitness` (`Pic0ChartLocus.lean:151`) — and its own docstring says this at length, under
    25	"A convention this predicate INHERITS" — asks for a divisor `W` in the presenting class with
    26	`Subsingleton H¹(𝒪(W))`, and asks for **neither `0 ≤ W` nor `deg W = g`**.  Effectivity and the
    27	degree normalisation are what the *chart map's injectivity* needs (GAP-2, `h⁰ = 1`), not what
    28	*membership of the locus* needs.
    29	
    30	The drop (`RiemannRoch/CoverageDrop.lean`) exists to manufacture exactly those two extra
    31	properties: it takes a degree-`g+e` witness with `h¹ = 0` and produces an effective `S` with
    32	`h⁰(W₀ − S) = 1`.  For membership, that work is thrown away — `mem_chartLocus_of_drop` returns
    33	the `IsSplitWitness` half from `hW₀`/`h1` alone, and its own proof shows this: the split witness
    34	comes from `isSplitWitness_of_witness_twistClass C μ m Z M₀ hM₀ W₀ hW₀ h1`, in which the drop,
    35	the oracle `P`, `hdense`, `hPcl`, `hPdeg`, `g`, `e`, `hχ` and `hdeg` **do not appear**.
    36	
    37	So the feedback of step 6 was an artefact of routing coverage through the drop.  Cut the drop
    38	and there is one `Z` again — the chart index's — and nothing to feed back.
    39	
    40	## What coverage then needs, in full
    41	
    42	Exactly one input beyond the landed splitting: a divisor of the twisted fibre class over the
    43	splitting field with vanishing `H¹`.  That is DAT-0a at the fibre field, and it is genuinely
    44	per-fibre (I-0204, `w4-datb` §0.2.2): no uniform `m₀` exists, so the exponent `m` must be chosen
    45	against `L`'s own threshold `b_L`.

    53	splitting field**.

     8	/-!
     9	# The canonical native rank-one presentation contract
    10	
    11	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` deliberately leaves the geometric producer fields explicit.
    12	This file fixes the module part of that contract: for a tied cocycle datum `D`, the module is
    13	always `D.nativeModule` and its base-ring comparison is always
    14	`D.nativeModuleKSheafIso`.  The native piece trivializations supply the line-bundle field;
    15	arbitrary-cartesian pushforward base change and the cohomology/rank certificates stay as
    16	explicit obligations.
    17	
    18	The resulting contract is therefore an adapter interface for a future producer, rather than a
    19	second choice of a line bundle.  Its conversion is consumed directly by the public
    20	`PicRankOneOpen` membership theorem below; no unrelated module or untied class can enter
    21	through this bridge, and the adapter itself does not provide the geometric certificates.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    30	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	
    34	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    35	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    36	
    37	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    38	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    39	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    40	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    41	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    42	
    43	/-! ## The native adapter contract -/
    44	
    45	/--
    46	A lambda-tied rank-one presentation whose module is canonically the native module of its
    47	cocycle datum.
    48	
    49	The fields after `datum_class` are exactly the remaining producer obligations.  The line-bundle
    50	certificate is derived from the canonical piece trivializations, so a field-level H⁰/H¹
    51	calculation or an unrelated line bundle cannot be silently substituted for the native
    52	evaluation module.
    53	-/
    54	structure PicRankOneNativePresentation
    55	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
    56	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
    57	  representative : descentClasses C cover
    58	  represents :
    59	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
    60	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
    61	  datum_class :
    62	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
    63	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
    64	  native_pushforward_base_change :
    65	    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    66	      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    67	      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
    68	      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    69	        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
    70	      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app datum.nativeModule)
    71	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
    72	  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    73	  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    74	  h0_rank_one :
    75	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
    76	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1
    77	
    78	namespace PicRankOneNativePresentation
    79	
    80	variable {pi} {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    81	
    82	/-- Convert the native adapter contract to the existing local-presentation contract.
    83	
    84	The two native bridge fields are inserted definitionally; all other fields are transported
    85	without weakening or adding hypotheses.
    86	-/
    87	noncomputable def toLocalPresentation
    88	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) :
    89	    PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam :=
    90	  { cover := P.cover
    91	    representative := P.representative
    92	    represents := P.represents
    93	    datum := P.datum
    94	    datum_class := P.datum_class
    95	    module := P.datum.nativeModule
    96	    module_iso := P.datum.nativeModuleKSheafIso
    97	    line_bundle := P.datum.nativeModule_isLineBundle
    98	    native_pushforward_base_change := P.native_pushforward_base_change
    99	    h1_vanishing := P.h1_vanishing
   100	    h0_finite := P.h0_finite
   101	    h0_projective := P.h0_projective
   102	    h0_rank_one := P.h0_rank_one }
   103	
   104	theorem nonempty_localPresentation
   105	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) :
   106	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :=
   107	  ⟨P.toLocalPresentation⟩
   108	
   109	end PicRankOneNativePresentation
   110	
   111	/-! ## Immediate rank-one-locus consumer -/
   112	
   113	/--
   114	An arbitrary-affine family of native contracts supplies the existing public rank-one-locus
   115	consumer.  The family is quantified in exactly the same way as
   116	`PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition`; the conversion only canonicalizes the module
   117	choice and does not manufacture any of the remaining geometric certificates.
   118	-/
   119	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations
   120	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   121	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   122	    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   123	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
   124	        Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi
   125	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
   126	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
   127	  apply mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi
   128	  intro A _ _ t
   129	  obtain ⟨P⟩ := h A t
   130	  exact P.nonempty_localPresentation
   131	
   132	end AlgebraicGeometry

    16	/-!

    18	
    19	An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
    20	rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
    21	map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
    22	test and ties every piece of data to the input class:
    23	
    24	* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
    25	* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
    26	* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
    27	* invertibility of the canonical native pushforward base-change mate on every cartesian square;
    28	* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.
    29	
    30	No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
    31	consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
    32	The method `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.h0BaseChange` derives arbitrary affine base change
    33	from the same presentation's `H^1`-vanishing field.  The section bridge at the end identifies
    34	datum `H^0` with native global sections and proves, by the adjunction triangle identity, that
    35	the evaluation counit sends the canonical unit-lift back to that same section.

    59	/-- A rank-one presentation of a genus-degree plus class on an affine test.

events.text: The audit found no mathematical defect in the producer: `baseSubtraction` folds the actual finite `Finsupp` support, and the residue-one proof is tied to the same `d.P` image. I found one concrete in-scope improvement: those compatibility theorems currently live only in the Pic0 specialization, so arbitrary-`mu` consumers must import a downstream file. I’m moving the exact general support/residue/base-class API into `Pic0RankOneTranslatedCoverGeneral.lean` and removing the duplicate Pic0 declarations; this preserves names and directly strengthens the general producer’s consumer surface without touching protected Phase 3/4 files.
